items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I remember once being in the Sunset when King Oliver came in

ctx.x: This was after he and Louie -- after Louie had gone out on his own---
Oh, yes--- well, I remember once being in the Sunset when King Oliver came in and I remember the night very well; I was with - it may have been George Wettling-----

items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: I was with some musician that, you know, that I knew and, uh, in comes Joe Oliver with a brown derby on

ctx.x: I was with some musician that, you know, that I knew and, uh, in comes Joe Oliver with a brown

derby on-- and his horn under his arms -- and, of course, Louie -- they were very great friends -- and Louie always considered him his teacher -- you know -- really. And, so, they got up on the stand together at the Sunset -- and they played about 125 choruses of "Tiger Rag"--- - exchanging choruses --
